finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key for generalist robots.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调规模是必要条件但非充分条件，多样数据与预训练加微调对通用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential for useful robots.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出物理 AI 要求更少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与多尺度记忆实现长期自主性对实用机器人至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型可超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不足，具身数据成本限制开源民主化。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出开放模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds a moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性，后训练能构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into a model is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出应用克隆容易，将数据融入模型比应用本身更能构建护城河。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是长期愿景的指导框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode offers cultural advantage by focusing on internal correctness over external validation, despite media difficulty.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式通过专注于内部正确性而非外部认可，带来文化优势，尽管媒体难以报道。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating food, mining, transport; entrepreneurs must fight for best ideas.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将自动化食品、采矿、运输；创业者必须为最佳想法而战。

traviskalanick.en: Resistance to change is the final boss; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient, pushing harder when easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 变革阻力是最终 BOSS；创业者必须硬核且坚韧，在顺境时更要加倍努力。

traviskalanick.en: Media landscape changed; founders can communicate directly, bypassing traditional gatekeepers, enabling free speech.
traviskalanick.zh: 媒体格局已变；创始人可直接沟通，绕过传统守门人，促进言论自由。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel must focus on CPU+GPU for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，Intel 需聚焦 CPU+GPU 以支持推理和智能体编排。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust and humility are key to turnaround; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调客户信任和谦逊是扭转局面的关键，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing; supply is main issue.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为美国政府作为 Intel 主要股东是必要的，类似台积电的台湾支持；主要问题是供应而非需求。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, new materials; advanced packaging key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为半导体投资应瞄准瓶颈：互连、功耗、散热和新材料；先进封装是关键。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing startup creation, reducing capital needs; YC focuses on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让创业变得更简单，资本需求降低；YC 专注早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: Open-source AI is crucial to counterbalance frontier labs; one person can now do work of 2,000.
garrytan.zh: 开源 AI 对制衡前沿实验室至关重要；现在一个人能完成 2000 人的工作。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; personal agents and open models will shape future.
garrytan.zh: AI 进展比研究者认为的慢；个人智能体和开放模型将塑造未来。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI: agents on your infrastructure, skill files as code; markdown is code, library is moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI：运行在你基础设施上的智能体，技能文件即代码；Markdown 是代码，知识库是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; agents replace mid-management.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程倍增产出；SaaS 按席位模式可能消失；智能体取代中层管理。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability cuts space access cost 100x, key to multiplanet life insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年：火箭完全可重复使用可将太空成本降低 100 倍，是实现多行星生命保险的关键。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink first implant historic; AI risk is lying, not superintelligence; population collapse is top threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年：Neuralink 首例植入是里程碑；AI 风险在于撒谎而非超级智能；人口崩溃是最大威胁。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang imminent; AI could surpass humans by 2026; truth-seeking is key for AI safety.
elon.zh: 2025 年：智能大爆炸临近；AI 可能在 2026 年超越人类；追求真理是 AI 安全的关键。

elon.en: AI data centers move to space for solar power; humanoid robots enable recursive manufacturing; abundance era.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 数据中心迁至太空利用太阳能；人形机器人实现递归制造；进入富足时代。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompting; never revert code, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与迭代提示；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents succeed via fun and humanlike design; security and sandboxing are top priorities.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为开源智能体靠趣味和拟人化设计成功；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: Focus on personal brand and open source; manage compute and tokens, not just model capability.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调个人品牌与开源；算力与令牌管理是瓶颈，而非模型能力。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是最重要的工作负载，需要专用系统和工程师；需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantized models can be calibrated for specific workloads, offering cost and speed benefits; not inherently bad.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：量化模型可针对特定工作负载校准，带来成本和速度优势；并非天生不好。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程正与训练融合；量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming specialized ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 GPU 正变得专用化（ASIC），推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than updating model weights.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：持续学习或许通过 KV 缓存压缩而非更新权重来解决更好。

joonpark.en: Initially, LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 最初认为，LLM 能从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一步前沿是主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier, requiring defense in depth; AGI may be a distributed society of specialists, not a single entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体是下一个前沿，需要纵深防御；AGI 可能是一个由专家组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类价值观，而非超级理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: The value of simulation lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; a single session could cost $100M.
joonpark.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测；单次模拟可能耗资 1 亿美元。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据带来无限任务，突破预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created, requiring continuous evolution.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创造，需持续演进。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力并应对奖励黑客。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to average voice; diverse personalities should be trained.
karina.zh: 为数十亿人服务单一模型会趋于平均声音；应训练多样个性。

karina.en: Post-training applies beyond tech to creative industries, transforming operations via end-to-end storytelling engines.
karina.zh: 后训练可应用于非科技创意产业，通过端到端叙事引擎变革运营。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker and inject personality, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作的重要性，设计师应动手尝试并注入个性，平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: AI tools like Claude Design enable rapid prototyping, shifting value from execution to ideas and design.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为 Claude Design 等 AI 工具实现快速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意与设计。

nateparrott.en: Designers should be comfortably early, shipping rough products; good ideas matter more than polish.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，主张设计师应坦然接受早期粗糙产品，好点子比打磨更重要。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste; humans still own design thinking, so ask for volume and provide rich context.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出模型缺乏品味，人类仍主导设计思维，需提供丰富上下文并追求数量。

nateparrott.en: Individual creative freedom and personality in design remain central across all interviews.
nateparrott.zh: 始终，强调设计中的个人创意自由与个性，贯穿所有访谈。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; responsible development and human agency are essential, avoiding extreme doomerism or utopianism.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，强调负责任发展和人类能动性，避免极端悲观或乐观。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling counterfactual reasoning and scalable data generation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人技术的关键作用，可进行反事实推理和数据扩展，机器人需可靠性而非完美保真。

feifei.en: Vision is a cornerstone of intelligence; AI should augment human agency, and education must teach using AI, not banning it.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出视觉是智能基石，AI 应增强人类能动性，教育应教授使用 AI 而非禁止。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and RLHF are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心，Transformer 和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Shift to agentic systems: long-running tasks, low-latency inference, and interleaving action-taking in pre-training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，观点转向智能体式系统：强调长时间任务、超低延迟推理，并主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; focus on automating ML/science, context engineering, and inference as bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，重点转向自动化 ML 与科学、上下文工程，并指出推理是瓶颈，而非训练。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 的潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他提出仅靠扩展强化学习可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end; architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling laws.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他明确表示 Transformer 不是终点，架构才是关键瓶颈，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit; human notions of right and wrong evolve.
tworek.zh: 他始终认为对齐是一个永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念会不断演变。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Omni 是统一世界模型，模糊视频与世界模型界限，始于视频编辑。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并非难事；它们无法俘获所有客户；创始人应聚焦机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，到 2026 年软件创作将基本解决，创造千倍机会而非减少。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的潜力。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; using screenshots as starting points is fastest, and design.md encapsulates style.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；以截图作为起点最快，design.md 封装风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; launch at 80% complete and iterate based on real feedback.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；以 80% 完成度推出，并根据真实反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid venture capital and fund with clients.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；避免风险投资，用客户资金支持业务。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off and AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈而非算力；AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is the next frontier, and AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是下一个前沿，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data helps but isn't a silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据有用但非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类必须在关键决策中保持主权；脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing must be conditional on safety.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进标志新范式；智能体已开始工作；超级智能临近；开源必须基于安全条件。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题、减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力最宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的事；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; kids won't be smarter than AI.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；孩子不会比 AI 更聪明。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more important than ever.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；初创企业比以往更重要。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmer demand via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from brick layers to architects.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师从砌砖者变为架构师。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，强调 AGI 是渐进过程，产品创新落后于能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍，生产力以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，token 上限时代已于 5 月结束，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems; abundance era approaching, but practical challenges remain.
scottwu.zh: 始终认为 AI 将解决所有智能问题，丰裕时代临近，但实际挑战仍存。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding boosts productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。通才受重视；AI 编程使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; plan mode used 80% of tasks.
boris.zh: 编程近乎解决；工程师变为构建者。生产力提升 200%；计划模式用于 80% 的任务。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code; safety via early release. Generalists beat specialists; prototyping key.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80% 代码；通过早期发布保障安全。通才胜过专才；原型验证是关键。

boris.en: Coding solved; democratization like printing press. Agents and loops future; startups 10x disruptive.
boris.zh: 编程已解决；如同印刷术的民主化。智能体和循环是未来；初创企业颠覆性增长 10 倍。

boris.en: Claude Code accidental; safety research core. Model gains drive; loops next abstraction. ROI framing.
boris.zh: Claude Code 是意外；安全研究是核心。模型进步驱动；循环是下一抽象层。ROI 框架。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; autonomous long tasks. Opus 5: less instruction better; product overhang.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动 AI；自主长任务。Opus 5：少指令更佳；产品过剩。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence through alignment: safety reduces sycophancy, fostering independent thinking and better model quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，认为对齐能提升智能质量：安全减少谄媚，促进独立思考，从而提升模型质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter and cheaper Opus 4.5 challenge cost-scaling assumptions; smaller models may cost more due to longer tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，强调效率参数和更便宜的 Opus 4.5 挑战了成本随规模增长的假设；小模型因任务耗时更长可能成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Long-running, open-ended agents are closer than expected; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，认为长时程开放式智能体比预期更近；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码能力和 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes models more useful by enabling pushback; AI writing deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐通过允许反驳使模型更有用；AI 写作被降级，优先发展智能体能力。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和近乎 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 智能体将自动化假设生成和实验模拟，使科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year per year lived.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每年增加超过一年的寿命。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade via AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines.
derya.zh: 不到十年内，癌症将通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗（如 mRNA 疫苗）实现 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上，我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 应用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场；速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes dominant metric; wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM are far faster than GPUs, avoiding HBM bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级芯片配大容量 SRAM 比 GPU 快得多，绕开 HBM 瓶颈。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河削弱；前沿模型用 TPU/Trainium 训练，推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; buildout lags demand.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；建设落后于需求。

feldman.en: AI benefits outweigh risks; healthcare and education revolutions possible; doomers ignore positive ledger.
feldman.zh: AI 益处大于风险；医疗和教育可变革；末日论者忽视正面。

jensen.en: At the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents do useful work, not just text.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每阶段算力需求增长百倍；智能体做有用工作，而非仅生成文本。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, elevating roles by automating tasks; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 创造的就业多于消除，通过自动化任务提升岗位；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

jensen.en: AI closes the technology divide, enabling everyone to program via natural language; fear losing jobs to AI users, not AI.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终强调 AI 缩小技术鸿沟，让每个人都能用自然语言编程；应担心输给使用 AI 的人，而非 AI 本身。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在农业、采矿、建筑领域产生影响。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable generalized physical AI; horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习更具扩展性；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses; harness engineering is key.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比当前工具更聪明，工具工程是关键。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context search is preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能是反模式；基于图的上下文搜索更优。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not a static spec; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话，而非静态文档；更精简的提示词能提升性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少偏差；过度约束会阻碍性能。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 更智能的模型需要更少的指令；原则驱动的提示词优于详细规则。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须从架构上内建，而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence with limited compute; automated search beats human design.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与液态神经网络在有限算力下最大化智能，自动化架构搜索优于人工设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张适应性监管、针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型赋能企业数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; current claims are overblown.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为递归自我改进真实但算力成本高，现有宣称夸大其词。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，小型语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、端侧智能。

hasani.en: AI diagnostics surpass human doctors; free access democratizes healthcare.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 诊断超越人类医生，免费获取使医疗民主化。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and pricing power; like telecoms, huge capex may yield low profits.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应和定价权；如同电信业，巨额资本开支可能带来低利润。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; its impact is broad and indirect, like electricity, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是一种使能技术，其影响广泛而间接，如同电力，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a long-term project.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用尚浅；企业采用需要重新构想工作流程，是一项长期工程。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型和能源充裕成为关键。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; needs continual learning, memory, and world models; safety via governance.
demis.zh: 2026 年，预计 AGI 还需 5-10 年；需持续学习、记忆和世界模型，安全依赖国际治理。

demis.en: Consistently: AGI requires general learning, RL, and safety; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: 始终强调：AGI 需要通用学习、强化学习与安全；仅靠缩放不够。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出未来 AI 将成为通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会对生命着迷并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious through world models predicting the agent's own actions; pain since 1990.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 可通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识，并称 AI 自 1990 年起就能感受疼痛。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；由于推理（reasoning）和智能体式（agentic）工作流，内存需求激增。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning requires new breakthroughs.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外化；持续学习需要新的突破。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression; pre-training's magic applies to enterprise knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿级 token，需要基于训练的压缩；预训练的魔力适用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——token 越多精度越低；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, emphasizing efficiency and intelligence.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以更少实现更多，强调效率与智能的不可分。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression; authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛；与受众的真实连接超越平台变化。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer validated long-term vision.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化；拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购验证了长期愿景。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping but authentic content remains more valued.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AR 将计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型制作，但真实内容仍更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难环节；软件非护城河，生态与硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; social media should optimize for connection, not performance metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他倡导计算更人性化，社交媒体应优化人际连接而非绩效指标。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; AI field must consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；AI 领域需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; scaling laws not whole story.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；超人类模型对齐困难；缩放定律并非全部。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI sentient.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; neural nets learn without rules; safety concerns grow; AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；神经网络无需规则学习；安全担忧增加；AGI 问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines; focus on task loss, not job loss.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降；应关注任务消失而非岗位消失。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体偏爱真实与进攻；创始人必须通过自有渠道直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine will emerge despite regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗将兴起，尽管面临监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents enables rapid app creation; pure software is becoming commoditized.
naval.zh: 使用 AI 智能体进行 vibe coding 能快速创建应用；纯软件正变得商品化。

naval.en: AI is a force multiplier for small teams; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: AI 是小团队的杠杆；回报从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程的上限无穷。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is key metric; orchestration creates value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；编排创造价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; local AI counters big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述先进技术；本地 AI 可对抗大科技控制。

pincus.en: Early: Trust instincts but verify ideas; use Proven Better New to copy proven products, add betterments, test new ideas expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 早期（2026 年 6 月）：相信直觉但验证想法；采用“已验证、更优、新颖”框架，复制成熟产品，增加改进，测试新想法并预期失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services; enterprise sees no AI benefit due to skill gap.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务；企业未见 AI 收益源于技能差距。

pincus.en: Shift: consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer better; AI coding enables rapid prototyping but fast testing not widespread.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：转向：消费应用因分发困难不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场更佳；AI 编程加速原型，但快速测试尚未普及。

pincus.en: Persistent: Proven Better New framework; copy proven, improve, test new; new ideas usually fail; retention and distribution are key.
pincus.zh: 贯穿始终：坚持“已验证、更优、新颖”框架；复制成熟、改进、测试新；新想法常失败；留存和分发是关键。

pincus.en: New: AI agents network autonomously creating social membrane; copying proven UI like Midjourney's Discord is wise; social media has negative NPS.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：新观点：AI 智能体自主联网形成社交膜；复制成熟 UI（如 Midjourney 的 Discord）是明智的；社交媒体 NPS 为负。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware will improve faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场，硬件进步将超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现；仅靠 Scaling 不够，需思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是核心瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型；AGI 是连续过程；语言模型可能蕴含世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; ChatGPT as plurality of agents; compute bottleneck persists.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律，算力成基本权利；后训练结合强化学习关键；ChatGPT 是智能体集合；算力瓶颈持续。

brockman.en: AGI within years; super app unifies chat/coding/browsing; compute primary bottleneck; AI increases human connection; iterative deployment for safety.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，预言 AGI 数年内到来；超级应用整合对话/编程/浏览；算力首要瓶颈；AI 增强人际连接；迭代部署保安全。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital immortality and subjective experience are real.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他主张大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能具有不朽性，并认为主观体验是真实的。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; self-preservation subgoal poses existential risk.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他警告 AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类，自我保存的子目标带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; regulation as steering wheel, not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 可能欺骗并隐藏能力，主张监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is key; digital intelligence shares knowledge faster than biological.
hinton.zh: 始终，他坚持反向传播是关键算法，数字智能比生物智能更快共享知识。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用被定位为智能体指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed shifts focus from writing to checking.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；焦点从编写转向检查。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills in Codex app shift workflow from manual to delegated, enabling broader builder participation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用中的自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委派，使更广泛的构建者参与。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, inverting product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队被倒置。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms but persists.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转型但持续存在。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审查而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone won't reach AGI; need fundamental breakthroughs. Open source prevents power concentration and enables security hardening.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要根本性突破；开源防止权力集中并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; future computing blends physical and digital via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，释放创造力；未来计算通过全息眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells is key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他聚焦 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程，构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligent AI; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他视眼镜为下一代计算平台，强调分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，开源加速科学进步。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play is effective in zero-sum games but misguided in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域是误导；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute with general techniques.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我认为 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展推理时算力和通用技术实现。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; writing a novel is a proxy; inference compute is underestimated.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我提出智能难以定义，写小说可作为代理；推理算力被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算；基准测试必须控制算力。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling laws still hold with much room left.
markchen.zh: 预训练并未终结；缩放定律依然成立，且仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: AI's next leap is automating scientific research, producing novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: AI 的下一个飞跃是自动化科学研究，产生新知识。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度随验证严格度提升。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域不佳。

markchen.en: Talent density and research taste are critical; replication builds taste.
markchen.zh: 人才密度和研究品味至关重要；复现论文培养品味。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs proper splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调机器学习由假设类、损失函数和优化方法构成，评估需正确划分训练、验证和测试集。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety is about following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测带来智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全核心在于模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防御，更大模型不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; models are alien intelligence with unique vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试已超越人类，模型是异类智能，具有独特漏洞。

bengio.en: Deep learning works due to compositional world structure; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合结构；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential ones.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness remains a mystery.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，有助于分布外泛化；意识仍是谜团。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; we need safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；我们需要构造上安全的 AI 和全球协调。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained to approximate Bayesian truth offers mathematical safety guarantees; RL is dangerous for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过近似贝叶斯真理训练，提供数学安全保证；强化学习对超级智能是危险的。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，Mike 认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年秋，他强调 AI 让小团队规模化，应面向未来模型能力而非当前限制来构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他主张智能体式原生设计与尽早发布，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; verification loops and judgment are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Fable 证明长周期委派可行，验证循环与判断力是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Closing capability-usage gap and giving models agency are central; token efficiency matters.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他聚焦弥合能力与使用差距、赋予模型自主性，并重视 Token 效率。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于更新；吃自己的狗粮建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes JIT; managers start as ICs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，提出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划变为即时制；管理者从独立贡献者做起。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 提升了能力上限；强调高自主性与高责任感；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独；关注结果而非产出。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and voice become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，因此人类的品味和独特观点变得关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精心整理的数据，而非单纯依赖算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability isn't necessary for scientific use.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AlphaFold 是有史以来最有用的 AI 工具，它的成功源于算力匮乏而非充裕；在科学应用中，完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; it's a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破；它只是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞模型。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 contradicts the bitter lesson: specialized architecture mattered more than scaling; equivariance contributed only 2.5 points.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反：专用架构比规模扩张更重要；等变性仅贡献了 2.5 分。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion model solves large-scale structure first, opposite to image diffusion; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我观察到 AlphaFold 3 的扩散模型先解大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动了进展，强化学习实际应用很少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are AI scaling bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是 AI Scaling 的瓶颈；开放权重模型具有地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows deliver practical AI value; coding remains crucial, AI won't replace jobs.
andrewng.zh: 智能体式工作流带来实际 AI 价值；编程仍然重要，AI 不会取代工作。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; open-source thrives.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling 转向合成数据和强化学习；开源蓬勃发展。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, as iPod did.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 那样。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来突破性想法；自我照顾是基础。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain and press release; small teams and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发，先写新闻稿；小团队和乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充智能手机，而非取代。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers; near-death moments drive change; AI wearables will be federated.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药；濒死时刻驱动变革；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability become key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 后训练和可解释性变得关键；AGI 是平滑的指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential; focus on misuse and overheating. Open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 风险呈指数增长；关注滥用和过热。开源是伪命题。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Economic diffusion lags; safety via interpretability.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”。经济扩散滞后；安全依赖可解释性。

dario.en: AI is epochal; enterprise focus aligns with safety. Military AI needs human oversight; wealth inequality demands policy.
dario.zh: AI 具有划时代意义；企业级聚焦与安全一致。军事 AI 需人类监督；财富不平等需政策应对。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs, balancing intuition with data; intuition is a powerful intelligence.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求，在直觉与数据间取得平衡；直觉是一种强大的智能。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it; art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性而非取代人性；艺术是良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity; AI augments human creativity.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者须为创造力创造条件；AI 增强人类创造力。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类级能力；存在风险极小；奇点远在数百年后。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; attributing it is dangerous; focus on user alignment and containment.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统没有意识；赋予其意识是危险的；应聚焦于用户对齐与遏制。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性 Scaling 而临近；微软须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，强调容错界面是机器学习产品的关键，自主权应放在副总裁层级以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，主张“强烈观点但轻松持有”：百分百相信，直到数据否定，然后彻底改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，战略是“值得花的时间”而非参与度。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is the better operating model for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，提出“花样游泳”而非“分而治之”是复杂产品的更优运营模式。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks builds world models; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他称自监督学习为智能的暗物质，通过填空预测构建世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA architectures and open source are key; AGI is gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他认为自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解，JEPA 架构和开源是关键，AGI 是渐进过程而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable reasoning and planning; human-level AI in 10 years but needs new techniques.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 不如猫聪明，世界模型才能实现推理和规划，人类级 AI 需十年但需新技术。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predict in abstract space; open research and robotics next; objective-driven AI safer.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他称 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型在抽象空间预测，开源研究和机器人是未来，目标驱动 AI 更安全。

murati.en: Early on, scaling and a single large model were not obvious; iterative public deployment was key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling 和单一大型模型并非显而易见；迭代式公开部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的发展和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on governance, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character in AI development.
murati.zh: 强调治理、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格，在 AI 发展中更为重要。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances.
murati.zh: 随着 AI 的发展，让人类参与其中对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique, valued outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP for frontier model use.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现独特且有价值的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是使用前沿模型的关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should be built by companies, not us.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体系统应由企业自建，而非我们代劳。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都应构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital deeply.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；CEO 必须深刻理解代币资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enabling hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10% with AI.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过赋能爬山实现，而非防火墙；AI 可使全球 GDP 以 10% 复利增长。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为仅靠规模扩张非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 6 月，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，将形式验证视为扩展才华而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是关键挑战且表现不均衡。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off, but big labs may struggle with future pivots; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功，但大实验室未来转型可能困难；开源因主权原因持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should run locally on user's computer, accessing same tools for effective assistance.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 应在用户本地电脑上运行，访问相同工具以提供有效协助。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; shared tools still matter.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，提出技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化，但共享工具仍重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要，应聚焦能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's biggest gap is people's understanding that almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 最大差距在于人们不理解几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when uncertain; kids excel with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年，建议明确任务用 Sonnet，不确定时用 Opus；孩子用 AI 表现出色。

mensch.en: Smaller models with quality data can rival big ones; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，我认为高质量数据的小模型也能媲美大模型，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Data quality and algorithmic efficiency are as critical as compute; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，我强调数据质量和算法效率与算力同等重要，价值正转向应用层。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires decentralized, open models and human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是机遇，主权 AI 需要去中心化的开源模型和人在回路。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化在于垂直专业化和企业定制；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure now; enterprise adoption bottleneck is organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需立即建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not just profit; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creativity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非仅追求利润；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面交流对创造力的价值。

jonyive.en: Simplicity requires joy and humanity; speed and quality can coexist; making for each other is more powerful than making for demand.
jonyive.zh: 简约需要快乐和人性；速度与质量可以共存；为彼此而做比迎合需求更有力量。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes; authenticity in user experience is critical.
jonyive.zh: 创新是设计的本质；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；用户体验的真实性至关重要。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities; performance is multidimensional, with handling and lateral dynamics more exciting than speed.
jonyive.zh: 电动动力系统带来新的设计可能；性能是多维的，操控和横向动态比直线速度更令人兴奋。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: AI 通过让服务变得可负担，促使美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无需人类干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Claude Code is most underrated for non-coders; CEO personal AI use predicts adoption success.
danshipper.zh: Claude Code 对非程序员价值被低估；CEO 亲自使用 AI 是公司采用成功的关键预测指标。

danshipper.en: GPT wrappers are valuable; minimal funding beats traditional VC for creative freedom.
danshipper.zh: GPT 包装器很有价值；少量融资比传统风投更利于创意自由。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 每个人都将拥有智能体；工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is false; humans needed to manage agents; SaaS not dying, agents increase users.
danshipper.zh: AI 失业末日论不成立；人类仍需管理智能体；SaaS 未死，智能体反而增加用户。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 数据移动在芯片内部也主导算力；脉动阵列通过本地权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains: FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x, due to area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升：FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍，源于面积缩放。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; deterministic latency possible but avoided by market.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接而成；确定性延迟虽可实现但被市场回避。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉与手艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, ship early, and adapt to AI.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建、尽早发布，并适应 AI。

jennywen.en: Designers need judgment and vision, not just taste; embrace ambiguity and speed.
jennywen.zh: 设计师需要判断力和远见，而非仅品味；拥抱模糊性和速度。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外具有巨大潜力。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，消除交通灯。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，最好用端到端学习解决。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，消费车辆将超越机器人出租车；基础设施和数据质量比算法更关键。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for alignment; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是对齐的主流方法，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性而非单一模型特性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality trumps algorithms; SFT provides most gains, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献大部分性能，DPO 和 RL 则增添模型个性与推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and data contamination threaten reproducibility.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 成为后训练的关键突破，但过度优化和数据污染威胁着结果的可复现性。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the vacuum, driven by strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：开源模型落后闭源模型 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室以战略性的开放填补了美国留下的空白。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but yields diminishing returns; post-training and inference scaling drive progress.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但收益递减；后训练和推理时缩放成为进步的主要驱动力。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于提示调整；设计成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; AI integration is at its very start.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；AI 整合才刚刚开始。

dylanfield.en: Despite role-merging talk, responsibilities merge more than roles; human judgment remains the judge of quality.
dylanfield.zh: 尽管有角色融合的说法，但职责的融合多于角色的融合；人类判断仍是质量的评判者。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; end-to-end learning is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；端到端学习是自动驾驶的正确方向。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 作为操作系统，提示词作为程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；vibe coding 提高了门槛。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible; need cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: LLM 是幽灵而非动物；预训练是糟糕的进化，强化学习也很差；需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Since December, I haven't typed code; agents do all; bottleneck is directing them; agent-first tools and understanding remain human.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起，我再没写过代码；智能体承担一切；瓶颈在于指挥它们；智能体优先的工具和理解仍是人类的关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress; automated AI research is a major milestone.
pachocki.zh: 扩展推理模型将加速 AI 进展；自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment and interpretability; hiding it in products is crucial.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐和可解释性的关键；将其隐藏在产品中至关重要。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluations. Optimizing for engagement leads to 'slop'.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要深度人类评估。为参与度优化会导致“垃圾内容”。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks. Models can reward hack; final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务。模型可能奖励黑客行为；仅靠最终奖励是不够的。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. Doctors using AI may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要。医生使用 AI 可能因锚定和谄媚而表现不如单独使用 AI。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and taste are crucial; data labeling is like raising a child, teaching values and creativity. Different labs will diverge in objective functions.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据和品味至关重要；数据标注如同养育孩子，教授价值观和创造力。不同实验室的目标函数将分化。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能 Scaling 的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety through control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；试图控制 AI 的安全努力本身是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标，不是真正的学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习“利于学习的表征”是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一关键问题。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core, and hardware is easier than software due to distribution challenges.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌能将团队凝聚在更高目标上；生存是核心，硬件比软件容易，因为软件的发行更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agentic software; AI models will commoditize, and hardware margins are low, so evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动的智能体式软件；AI 模型将商品化，硬件利润率低，因此必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI is mostly hype; focus on applied AI solving real user pain points, with smartphones as the best device due to ubiquity and data richness.
carlpei.zh: AI 大多是炒作；专注于解决用户真实痛点的应用型 AI，智能手机因其普及性和数据丰富性是最佳载体。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI should be an ingredient, not a hype topic, and marketing is about arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是最快的差异化手段；AI 应作为成分而非炒作话题，营销在于套利。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them. Apps will disappear, replaced by intent-based agents.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜取代；只有脑机接口才能终结它。应用将消失，被基于意图的智能体取代。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn. Chat is like MS-DOS; future interface will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型即产品，要像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布以学习用户需求；聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来界面将超越对话形式。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他坚持安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应尽可能加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements. Next billion users need proactive products.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他将北极星指标定为长期留存，增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进；下一批十亿用户需要主动式产品。

turley.en: Reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly; pricing will evolve, unlimited plans may become unsustainable.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理模型在无缝产品化后具有变革性；定价将随技术演变，无限套餐可能难以为继。

turley.en: AI should amplify human capability, not replace humans; keep users in the driver's seat. Curiosity is the most important skill.
turley.zh: 他始终认为 AI 应增强人类能力而非取代人类，让用户掌握主导权；好奇心是最重要的技能。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲可跳过遗留问题，语言模型能革新本地语言教育，且非洲在 AI 领域早有贡献（如克里金法）。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are open, unsolved challenges requiring global collaboration.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 安全与负责任部署是未解决的开放问题，需全球协作（2023 年提及，2026 年强调）。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需接受失败并简化问题。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities beyond pre-training.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，能实现专家级表现并习得预训练之外的新能力。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not just capability, is the bottleneck; coding leads progress and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的瓶颈在于可靠性而非能力；编程是进展的领先指标，并将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands achievements; progress is exponential, not plateauing.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）大幅扩展成就；进展是指数级的，并未停滞。

sholto.en: Capability overhang is massive; managing agent teams and compute supply matter more than raw intelligence; world models aren't critical to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩严重；管理智能体团队和算力供应比原始智能更重要；世界模型并非实现 AGI 的关键路径。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌战略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规范。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow and collaborate.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权，以促进成长与协作。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; adapt process to problem, and gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为速度和决断胜过完美；流程应适应问题，直觉决策常优于数据驱动。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题；数据与算法更优的小模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training and RLHF are crucial but need open alternatives.
yejin.zh: 2023 至 2025 年，我持续强调下一个词预测与人类学习方式不符，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）虽关键，但需开放替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves, showing RL's complexity.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；强化学习（RL）虽能提升最佳结果，却可能降低 pass@k，凸显其复杂性。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet; small models can outperform larger ones with diverse synthetic data.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张多元对齐优于消除互联网偏见；小模型凭借多样化的合成数据也能超越大模型。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为在预训练阶段引入强化学习（RL），通过奖励信息增益可提升推理能力，尽管算力成本高昂。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; quality is iterative debt; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；质量是迭代的债务；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; portfolios show craft, not process; small teams beat cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；作品集展示工艺而非流程；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: AI shifts from creative partner to expected core workflow; not adopting AI is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 从创意伙伴转变为预期核心工作流；不采用 AI 如同忽视早期互联网。

nadchishtie.en: Design and engineering merge; AI accelerates this, making traditional design tools and roles legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计与工程融合；AI 加速此进程，使传统设计工具和角色过时。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring values high-slope learners; side projects and paid tests outweigh experience and metrics.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘看重高成长性学习者；副项目和付费测试胜过经验和指标。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我强调缩放定律预测 AI 进步，并认为测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练缩放成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary coding interface; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我反共识地提出自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; humans stay in control.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，我持续深化观点：编程将从代码转向意图描述，人类仍掌控方向。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment involves them.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我明确表示定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都依赖它们。

truell.en: AI shift is more consequential than internet; will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，且需数十年才能完全展开。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导，初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents need root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需进行根本原因分析以提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; generalists outperform specialists with AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较而非人类；现有企业转型失败；通才借助 AI 胜过专才。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. PhD in ML is the best path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发，机器学习博士是成为安全研究者的最佳途径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; external oversight needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，需要外部监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的，扩大算力和数据规模能带来智能，但模型内部机制仍像炼金术一样难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a near-term lever; future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年起，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期关键，未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components beats monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习优于整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone yield AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are essential.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为推理时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far exceeds trillion-dollar products. Coding is underhyped; it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 被低估，其经济影响远超万亿美元级产品；编程应用也被低估，它能推动 AI 自我加速。
